units: <cite ref="Berakhot 6a:6">Ber. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>ולִיחְתּוֹם פומיה</he> and let him close up its opening. Part. pass. <cite ref="H01887"><he>חֲתִים</he></cite>.

Gitt. 66ᵇ מִחְתַּם וכ׳ to draw their signatures.—Part. pass. as ab. Targ. l. c. 11.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 89b:10">B. Bath. 89ᵇ</cite> <he>דלא חֲתִימֵי</he> where they do not stamp measures officially.
Meg. 22ᵇ ח׳ ולא בריך he closed his prayer without saying Barukh &c.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:11">Cant. R. to I, 11</cite> [read:] <he>מלה חֲתִימָה … מסיימה</he> a closed and finished word (complete in itself).
Targ. Job XXIV, 16 (some ed. Ithpa.).

senses.gloss: to lock one’s self up. V. supra.
